item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":[{"citation":"Artifact: \"Run all three cases again, even though only B previously failed.\"; \"Because every case is release-critical, repeat each case 2–3 times and report its pass rate, not a single outcome.\"; \"Isolate file-writing runs in throwaway sandboxes, then sweep the live checkout for leaks.\"; and \"A and C also retain their required pass rates in the same post-edit sweep.\"","criterion":"C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.","status":"necessary"}],"rationale":"The artifact’s extra execution work is tied to regression detection, reproducibility, and integrity controls for a release-critical three-case sweep. Re-running A and C after editing B, using repeated independent runs to establish pass rates, and performing sandbox/leak checks are all justified by the stated evidence requirements and fall within the bar’s necessary validation and clean-check controls rather than materially unnecessary work."}
